parts.text: Audrey has to take two math tests to pass 6th grade.
She must correctly answer 70% of the total questions to move on to the 7th grade.
The first test has 70 questions and she gets 60% of them correct.
The second test has a few questions.
Before taking the second test, she still need 35 questions to get right on it to move onto the 7th grade.
How many questions are there in the second test?
